text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to elevate Curren 
Chan's skills begins today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The training camp was right on the beach. 
Curren Chan was overjoyed, eager to take 
lots of cute videos.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recording video during training was 
strictly forbidden, however. It seemed she 
wanted to show off her cuteness only when 
it was under complete control.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan aimed for perfection in both 
her cuteness and the fruits of her 
training.
